properties.title: Cuba (Havana José Martí MUHA): AMBER 72h weather window — heavy rain likely (75%) on 2026-11-25; tonight 0.0 h low-light dark
properties.summary: Across 82 ensemble members, heavy rain at Havana José Martí (MUHA) is likely (55-80%) to reach the amber threshold (25.0 mm/24h) on 2026-11-25 UTC (72-hour stoplight: Amber). Tonight's lunar illumination is 99% with 0.0 hours of nautical darkness under low moon. By model: GEFS 20 of 31, ECMWF 44 of 51, weighted equally. Not sent to COP as a warning: the grid cell could not be checked against the station.

raise_by: a further independent line of evidence (have 2, High needs 3)
a scored Verdict record for this method version

alternatives.hypothesis: Weather remains below the operational threshold or passes in brief (< 3 h) local showers
alternatives.tell_apart: Subsequent 00Z/12Z ensemble runs drop below 20% member agreement or METAR at MUHA stays under 25.0 mm/24h

alternatives.hypothesis: Single-model bias between NOAA GEFS and ECMWF IFS inflates the tail probability
alternatives.tell_apart: Spread between GEFS (31) and ECMWF (51) member fractions exceeds 35 percentage points

resolution.rule: Yes if ICAO station MUHA (Havana José Martí) records heavy rain >= 25.0 mm/24h on 2026-11-25 UTC.
resolution.source: NOAA Aviation Weather Center METAR / SYNOP archive for MUHA (https://aviationweather.gov/data/metar/?ids=MUHA)
